row_grain.inventory: one retained official source inventory row
row_grain.injection_monthly: one retained official source monthly row, including conflicts/revisions

missing_value: CSV empty cell / JSON null for absent numbers. Zero remains zero. String identifier absence is empty string.
pressure_basis: Reported injection pressure, psi as named by RRC manual pp.40–41 (PDF pp.41–42). No datum conversion, BHP, reservoir pressure, or injectivity claim.
annulus: Not available in ODP dataset qq2j-f2zm; no annulus columns are generated.
revision_policy: Every source row retained; duplicate period or report ID quarantined without selecting a preferred revision. most_recent_record preserved without using it as a revision selector.

units_source.note: Official UIC manual defines liquid barrels, gas MCF, monthly average/maximum psi; public UIC query help names permit limits PSI and BBLS/day.

source_record_key.definition: Snapshot plus 1-based raw inventory ordinal; never shortened API

uic_number.definition: Original nine-character UIC parent/control ID; preserves leading zeros

api_no.definition: Original API_NO exactly as source supplies it (eight digits here); never used as join key

operator_number.definition: Original source operator_number; identifier values preserved as strings

district_code.definition: Original source district_code; identifier values preserved as strings

lease_number.definition: Original source lease_number; identifier values preserved as strings

lease_name.definition: Original source lease_name; identifier values preserved as strings

well_no_display.definition: Original source well_no_display; identifier values preserved as strings

county.definition: Reeves from source API county prefix 389; metadata not independently geocoded

injection_type_code.definition: Original source injection_type_code; identifier values preserved as strings

permit_liquid_pressure_limit_psi.definition: ODP max_liq_inj_pressure; regulatory authorized maximum, not sustainable capacity

permit_liquid_volume_limit_bpd.definition: ODP bbl_vol_inj; authorized maximum liquid volume, not sustainable capacity

permitted_top_depth_ft.definition: ODP top_inj_zone; permitted injection interval top

permitted_bottom_depth_ft.definition: ODP bot_inj_zone; permitted injection interval bottom

w14_number.definition: Original source w14_number; identifier values preserved as strings

w14_date.definition: Original source w14_date; identifier values preserved as strings

permit_canceled_date.definition: Original source permit_canceled_date; identifier values preserved as strings

plugged_date.definition: Original source plugged_date; identifier values preserved as strings

source_snapshot_id.definition: Dataset ID plus raw response SHA256 prefix

source_row_key.definition: Snapshot plus 1-based raw monthly ordinal; preserves duplicate source IDs

parent_key.definition: Unique UIC inventory source_record_key if and only if exact string UIC matches one retained parent

source_report_id.definition: Original ODP monthly id, retained without assuming global uniqueness

period_start.definition: Calendar month start from formatted_date; not a daily observation

injected_liquid_bbl.definition: ODP vol_liq, monthly total liquid volume

injected_gas_mcf.definition: ODP vol_gas, monthly total gas volume

reported_avg_injection_pressure_psi.definition: ODP inj_press_avg; separate reported average injection pressure

reported_max_injection_pressure_psi.definition: ODP inj_press_max; separate reported maximum injection pressure

calendar_days.definition: Actual Gregorian days in reporting month

calculated_calendar_day_avg_bpd.definition: injected_liquid_bbl / calendar_days; not measured daily operating rate or operating-day rate

most_recent_record.definition: Original ODP flag; meaning not documented by metadata, no revision-selection inference
